goal: Lock Bora's Claude-first, G-adjudicated Cable One DOCX as the gold-quality resume acceptance reference for future Career OS packages, preserving the current visual grammar while requiring truthful JD-to-evidence overlap, recruiter-natural story coherence, and interview-defensible wording without building a generator or changing Candidate Truth.
acceptance_conditions: the exact gold-quality acceptance artifact is Bora_Chaush_Cable_One_Claude_First_G_Adjudicated.docx with SHA-256 ec3a9f9c6e2fc429e01892f61a074a71319ec6586566b6c1cf60808eba2f3f70; the binary need not be stored in the repository, but its identity and extracted acceptance contract must be recorded
this artifact supersedes prior Cable One and Spy Pond exemplars only as the latest resume package quality/presentation acceptance reference; it is never a source of Candidate Truth

the locked family remains one U.S.-Letter page by default, one column, centered name/contact block, readable roughly 10-11 point body type, thin section rules, conventional black-and-white hierarchy, natural vertical rhythm, at least 92 percent meaningful page utilization, DOCX-first when accepted, and real hyperlink objects

default section grammar remains natural summary with no PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading, then EDUCATION, SKILLS, WORK EXPERIENCE, RELEVANT PROJECT; work headers remain Title | Employer with right-aligned dates; two-school education and three natural skills rows remain the default grammar

future tailoring must operate through verified JD -> canonical Requirement/EvidenceMatch state -> approved Candidate Truth/evidence -> package decision; supported employer terminology may be used naturally, while NONE or UNKNOWN tools/capabilities remain absent

the package must surface the strongest role-relevant supported evidence across summary, skills, bullet ordering, project selection, and page-space allocation without changing the underlying qualification result or hiding material gaps

the resume must read as one coherent human career story rather than disconnected keyword blocks: current career stage and education establish context, skills preview evidenced capability, work bullets prove applied capability, and project evidence supplies technical/analytical proof where relevant

candidate-facing language is ordinary direct American English; internal Career OS, governance, evidence-system, implementation-control, or AI-process terminology must be translated into recruiter-natural wording unless that terminology is itself genuinely job-relevant evidence

bullets prefer action plus context plus evidence-supported outcome/value; when no measured outcome exists, use action plus context or purpose without manufacturing impact, and normally keep bullets to one or two rendered lines where practical

quantification is used only when approved evidence supports it and when it helps a recruiter understand scale, result, or complexity; no invented percentages, productivity estimates, derived annualized figures, or decorative metrics

the strongest current/relevant experience receives the most evidence space by default; secondary experiences and projects receive less, unless the JD crosswalk materially earns a different evidence budget

Norma_Resume is retained only as external comparison evidence supporting conventional one-column density, visible tools, action-led bullets, and substantial page use; it must never become a second Bora template or override Bora's own gold reference

final package QA must test truth fidelity, JD/evidence coverage, human naturalness, interview defensibility, reference conformance, rendered one-page quality, and functional hyperlinks before Bora's human gate

Claude may draft candidate-facing wording only from the verified JD, approved crosswalk, approved Candidate Truth/evidence, and canonical gold grammar; G must reject unsupported or less-natural language and remains responsible for final adjudication, document construction, render QA, and hyperlinks
no end-to-end generator, schema change, Candidate Truth change, Match Truth change, qualification/pursuit runtime change, or protected resume-master change is introduced
stop_conditions: the lock would require changing Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/pursuit logic, schemas, runtime product code, or the protected resume master
the lock would turn Cable One-specific factual wording into universal resume text instead of preserving only the quality/presentation/story/overlap behavior
the lock would weaken first-party role verification, truth lineage, DOCX-first submission, the 92 percent page-utilization floor, real hyperlink verification, or rendered-artifact QA
the lock would authorize keyword stuffing, unsupported tools, invented results/metrics, or hiding a material qualification gap
research_basis: Cable One first-party Business Analyst I posting: operational data analysis, trends, reporting models/KPIs, operational efficiency, cross-functional work, reconciliation, 1-2 years or equivalent education/experience, and advanced Excel/data management preferred
Yale Office of Career Strategy: simple readable one-page formatting, standard fonts, role-relevant action-led accomplishment bullets, and JD-aligned transferable skills
University of Pennsylvania Career Services: one-page consistent formatting, 1-2 line action-led bullets with context, transferable skills, and results/quantification where meaningful
U.S. Department of Labor VETS Resume Essentials 2026: targeted achievement statements, everyday language, action verbs, and job-posting skill alignment
Indeed 2026 ATS guidance: use job-description keywords naturally while writing for both ATS and human recruiters
Norma_Resume external comparison: conventional one-column structure, dense-but-readable page use, visible tools, and action-led evidence; comparison evidence only, never Bora template authority
